_comment: Hand-maintained: fake-shop and skimmer kits security researchers have published indicators for. A page matches a kit only by two or more different traces, since one name can also appear in a legitimate detector that lists it: a script loaded from a file with the kit's name, a host the page contacted, or an identifier inside the code of a script the page runs. The same names in an article's text (a page about the kit) do not count. Every entry needs a report that names its indicators.
